create_Demo_dataset: create a Demo dataset instance with a ROOT directory path and configurable sequence parameters
run_Demo_get_views: run the Demo _get_views method to load images, depthmaps, and camera poses from a directory
review_Demo_class: review the Demo class that extends BaseManyViewDataset for loading multi-view image sequences with optional depth
summarize_Demo_init: summarize the Demo constructor parameters including num_seq, num_frames, min_thresh, max_thresh, full_video, and kf_every
test_Demo_dataset: test the Demo dataset by instantiating it with a ROOT path and calling _get_views to verify image loading
